main_body: white porcelain bathtub with a water-filled basin, seen from the south, with two small brown feet
top_band: Rows 3-4 are a white back rim, rows 5-9 show the blue water interior (dark blue at row 5, then light blue), and rows 10-11 are a white front rim. Together they form a horizontal top of about 8-9 rows.
evidence: In the middle column a back rim (rows 3-4) leads to a dark-to-light blue water ellipse, which gives a visible opening about 5 rows tall (rows 5-9). A bright front rim (rows 10-11) follows, then a greyer front face with a shaded lower band (rows 12-14) and feet below. The top surface and the south face are both clearly drawn, and the basin interior can be seen from above, so it reads as 3/4.

style.evidence: The water is a big near-flat light-blue block with one dark top row and a single highlight pixel. The white rim and the grey front face are smooth bands with almost no grain or speckle. The outline is a neutral dark grey, not a tinted material tone. The piece has about 4 lightness steps against 5-6 in the references, and its tiles carry only a few colours each, well below the cheese stall and the roofed well.
